DIAGNOSIS DISAGREEMENTS (colour agreed, cause not — all three matter for the worklist): T861 gives regression-git-commit-mine.sh disposition `deploy` (it is the worktree guard's absolute-threshold defect; `deploy` would never fix it); T861 records regression-subagent-prompt.sh red/`repair` (it PASSES at HEAD in a scrubbed environment; what needs repairing is its inheritance of the caller's depth); T861 keeps battery-baselines/-sweep in the red baseline while correctly marking them not-precommit (they are NOT RED — the baseline overstates redness by two).
WATCHDOG: T861 recorded four of its 24 as "killed as silent at the 60s wall cap (fleet-keeper, managent-memory-safety, process-ownership, watch-fleet)". With a 300s watchdog all four produced a real named failure (98s, 94s, 66s, >300s). NOT COMPUTABLE: the difference against the FIRST sweep ("23 of 86"). Only its count was recorded, never its list. A count without its list cannot be diffed — which is why this document publishes the list.
